overwriteIncident.trigger: evidence/omo-align/verification/run.mjs (not authored by Lead) wrote its own much smaller result.json to the DELIVERED path on every re-run.
overwriteIncident.rootCause: the driver's output write targeted the delivered artifact name; the driver also carried a manualEntries comparison that could never pass (constant-derived name list missing agent_teams_task_contract vs the 14-name frozen list), so each re-run emitted verdict=needs_revision over the delivered report.

prevention: 1. The driver never writes a delivered name: run.mjs now writes raw/run-<UTC stamp>.json and raw/run-<UTC stamp>.output.log; the old write site at the delivered path is removed (only write sites left are the two raw/ paths).
2. A re-run gets a NEW timestamped name (stated in an English binding comment at the top of run.mjs: 'NEVER OVERWRITE A DELIVERED ARTIFACT ... a re-run writes a NEW timestamped file').

3. Delivered artifacts are effectively read-only after delivery: result.json is byte-identical to raw/t17-report-restored.json, so any future same-name writer cannot erase the content; recovery is a single copy.
